"summary":"The saved mask comes from the only successful cell, C9. In C9, target-period SST (2022-06-01 to 2022-08-31) for every sea cell is compared against Hazen 90th-percentile thresholds, which are then smoothed over 31 days and indexed by the target days of year 153-244. Through the 31-day smoothing and the ±5-day pools, those thresholds draw on baseline values from 12 May to 20 September in each year 1992-2002; the hot days then go through run detection and gap joining, and the result is written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
